summary: Virax Biolabs Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting an inducement offer letter with a holder to exercise existing warrants for 548,000 ordinary shares at a reduced price of $6.00 per share, raising ~$3.3 million in gross proceeds. In exchange, the company issued new Series A and Series B preferred investment options exercisable at $6.00 per share. The placement agent is H.C. Wainwright & Co. The transaction includes a shareholder meeting to approve an authorized share increase. This is a warrant exercise inducement and equity line financing, not a special situation.
